title: The ET's account: galactic monitors of life, sent by 'God'
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of The ET's account: galactic monitors of life, sent by 'God', about unspecified at Nevada test site and Area 51, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he said that you know he was part of a group uh of people beings from different star systems in our galaxy.

plain: Danny Sheehan, a lawyer active in UFO disclosure circles, told podcast host Jesse Michels about records of an interview with an extraterrestrial, written on index cards and tied to a man named Oscar Wolf, connected to S4, a reported secret site near Area 51, the classified Air Force base in Nevada. According to Sheehan, the being said he belonged to a group of beings from different star systems in our galaxy who monitor life, sent by what he called God. If true, it would mean Earth is being watched over by a kind of galactic council.
